description.value: Your community often put up performances and parties for the departed during the passing of seasons, inviting them to your homes and towns to see each other again. You become trained in Performance, and you can use Performance in place of a skill used in Rituals that pertain to summoning the undead creatures or spirits, or to create costumes, wards or disguises that could invoke meaning or value to an intelligent undead. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perform for undead creatures, or people who share a culture that respects those who have passed.
